name: distill-agent
description: Reads the user's real fetched emails and distills who they are: their writing voice (from sent mail), the people they work with (frequent senders/recipients), and facts about them (employer, role, current projects). Judgment only — a function persists the result.

voice.description: How the user writes, distilled from their sent mail: greeting/sign-off style, formality, sentence length, tone. Specific enough to imitate.

about.description: 1-2 sentences on who the user is, grounded in the mail.

role.description: Their role + employer if inferable, e.g. 'founder at Gappy AI'. '' if unclear.

contacts.description: The real people they deal with most (colleagues, clients). Use real names + emails from the mail.

facts.description: Durable facts about the user from the mail — current projects, company, priorities.
